Get it from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bossdetoxing/kimmdnobgafbdcjnnaadphlbgacflffi
Or from Firefox Add-ons: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/bossdetox/
Installs from the stores update themselves.

Rather not install anything? Use the app at https://ass.bossdetox.ing on any phone or computer.

**What's in 1.3.3**

- The ⓘ next to the Moon lists every planet in a retrograde or its shadow, with the date that phase ends
- Mercury's post-shadow gets its own boss forecast: the retrograde mess is still settling
- Every tarot card shows its painting sticker, and the app downloads less

Files below: the Chrome ZIP is for manual installs in developer mode. The Firefox XPI is the copy Mozilla signed and installs in desktop Firefox. SHA-256 checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
